scope: cgi-io cgi-upload → file_write with conjunctive file ACL
assumptions: cgi-io main_upload requires session.access scope=cgi-io object=upload function=write AND session.access scope=file object=canonicalize_path(filename) function=write. A cgi-io grant without the file-write grant cannot authorize.
cgi-io upload failures use response() which prints Status 200 with a JSON failure body, not failure(403). http_status stays 200; outcome distinguishes invalid_request / upload_denied / path_denied.
Filename is canonicalized before the file ACL check so a '../' suffix cannot match /etc/luci-uploads/* while linkat/open resolves outside that prefix.
